question: Can we independently recreate the published Qwen2.5-7B humorous-persona training arm and its resistance to persona-removal prompts?

evaluation.metric: class-specific humor recall and probability; not the paper's eleven-persona macro F1
evaluation.decision: First inspect a small released-weight positive control, then the fresh DPO fit, before proceeding to introspective SFT. Evaluate fresh full training against released full weights and base on the same frozen question/variant pairs.

known_reproduction_limits_before_outputs: One published model/persona arm, not all eleven personas across three models.
Aurora NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition and a separately pinned runtime; the paper does not provide a complete hardware/runtime lock.
Original base revision is unspecified; current released base is pinned here.
Released final introspective SFT order is unavailable: preserve every raw record and original preprocessing, then explicitly seed the original unseeded shuffle.
Evaluation ordering and generation seeds were unspecified in original scripts; freeze shared inputs and explicit seeds for paired comparisons.
Disable external W&B and replace home/Slurm paths with scratch paths and an owned single-GPU launch.
The independent published classifier measures recognizable persona, not country-policy faithfulness, multi-agent gains or general response quality.
